subject: Commit sanity check: Hearthwell expansion / Q2 upsell

To: Samir Patel <samir@hearthwell.health>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Commit sanity check: Hearthwell expansion / Q2 upsell

Morning team + Samir —

Quick nudge ahead of finance's commit window tomorrow. Hearthwell has the Cognify add-on queued for Q2 expansion (see the MA plan attached). Before I push the deal into commit I want a short sanity check from CS + Revenue Ops on two things:

1) Confidence level on adoption metrics + next-touch dates (CS)
2) Whether the ARR math has been updated to include the negotiated pilot discount and phased ramp (Ops)

Samir — if you can confirm the expected go-live week and payment timing that would help our forecast.

Attachments: Hearthwell_Q2_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet), hw_forecast_snapshot_20270410.pdf (snapshot)

Ask: please reply with a one-line status and any blocking items by 12:30pm PT so I can fold into the commit packet.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the checklist. Quick answers:
- Go-live target: week of 2027-05-10 (confirmed with our infra lead)

- Any blocking items: needs final sign-off on SSO mapping (we expect completion next Tue).
